test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 03 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Rajinder drives his car at an average speed of 40 km per hour to cover half of his total distance and thereafter he increase his speed to 60 km per hour. He covers his journey in 7 hours. What is the average speed of Rajinder in this journey?
solution:
**Given:**

Rajinder's speed = 40 km/h.

He increased his speed to 60 km per hour.

He covers his journey in 7 hours.

**Concept used:**

If for the same distance one speed V and another speed U then average speed will be,

⇒ 2 (V × U) / (V + U)

**Calculation: **

The average speed will be

⇒ 2 × 40 × 60 /( 40 + 60)

⇒ 4800 /100 = 48 km/h

**∴ The correct option is 2**
